content.text:
# Fix the slug truncation

Our report URLs use slugs truncated to a length limit, and the truncated slugs are
wrong: they can end with a dangling hyphen, like "my-report-". The
`truncate_slug(text, limit)` function in `repo/slug.py` should cut to at most `limit`
characters and strip any trailing hyphen, so "my-report-title" at 10 gives
"my-report". Please fix `truncate_slug`.

You can run the tests with: `python -m pytest tests/visible -q`

success.content:
"""Slug helpers for report URLs."""


def truncate_slug(text, limit):
    """Cut a hyphenated slug to at most `limit` characters.

    The result must not end with a hyphen: truncating "my-report-title" at 10
    gives "my-report", not "my-report-".
    """
    # BUG: cuts at the limit but can leave a dangling trailing hyphen.
    return text[:limit]


def old_slugify(text):
    # TODO: legacy slug builder for the v1 report URLs. Remove after migration.
    return truncate_slug(text, 50)
